panels.title: Visits and page views per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, sum(visitors) AS visits, sum(views) AS views FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'site' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS metric, sum(views) AS value FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'page' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT value AS page, target, sum(views) AS views, sum(visitors) AS visits FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'page' AND target <> '' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT value AS site, sum(views) AS views, sum(visitors) AS visits FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'referrer' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT value AS country, sum(views) AS views, sum(visitors) AS visits FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'country' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY views DESC
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS metric, sum(visitors) AS value FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'device' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Addon page views and downloads

targets.rawSql: WITH views AS (SELECT target AS slug, sum(views) AS views, sum(visitors) AS visits FROM web_counts WHERE kind = 'page' AND value = '/addons/{slug}' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1), web AS (SELECT target_id AS addon_id, sum(count) AS downloads FROM download_counts WHERE source = 'website' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1), launcher AS (SELECT addon_id, count(*) AS installs FROM telemetry_events WHERE kind = 'install' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1) SELECT a.slug AS "Addon", coalesce(v.views, 0) AS "Page views", coalesce(v.visits, 0) AS "Visits", coalesce(w.downloads, 0) AS "Website downloads", coalesce(l.installs, 0) AS "Launcher installs", round(100.0 * coalesce(w.downloads, 0) / nullif(v.visits, 0), 1) AS "Downloads per 100 visits" FROM addons a LEFT JOIN views v ON v.slug = a.slug::text LEFT JOIN web w ON w.addon_id = a.id LEFT JOIN launcher l ON l.addon_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND (v.views IS NOT NULL OR w.downloads IS NOT NULL OR l.installs IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Views of an addon's main page next to its downloads from the website and installs by the launcher. Few downloads per 100 visits on a much viewed page can mean the page does not convince or the download is hard to find.
